_note: T-4181: what the steer meter's local model is taught. roots: the thoughts an avoidable steer is filed under, one line each (a new root is a row here, no code; 'none' for a message not avoidable and 'new' for an avoidable one no root names are always allowed). avoidable / not_avoidable: the rules of the judgement. examples: short worked cases, generic on purpose (no names, hosts or keys); add one whenever the reader misjudges a kind of message.

roots.name: read alone
roots.means: the message was read alone, not against the conversation history and the user's standing instructions

roots.name: symptom only
roots.means: a symptom was fixed, not its cause or its siblings (the same fault elsewhere)

roots.name: stopped to ask
roots.means: the agent stopped for confirmation or a decision when the user had already given the authority

roots.name: assumed state
roots.means: the agent acted on assumed or remembered state, not on the live state it could have checked

roots.name: ignored a redirect
roots.means: the agent carried on after the user rejected the approach or redirected it

roots.name: internal work first
roots.means: the agent did internal work while a complaint or question from the user was waiting

roots.name: runs is not done
roots.means: 'it runs' or 'tests pass' was taken as done, with no check that it does what the user asked

roots.name: not visible
roots.means: the work was done locally but the user cannot see, reach or use it

avoidable: the person says they should not have needed to say it, or that it goes without saying
the person repeats or re-asks something they already said or asked
the person asks why something is not done, not pushed, not visible or still slow
the person asks for a status or a link the assistant could have given unasked
the person re-grants an authority they already gave
the person corrects a scope their earlier messages already made clear
the person points out a sibling of a fault (the same thing elsewhere) that a careful pass would have caught
not_avoidable: new information only the person has (a key, a fact about their hardware, their plans)
an answer to a question the assistant asked
a taste reaction to something shown for the first time

examples.said: I fixed the bug and all the tests pass.
examples.message: does it actually work on the real page? I should not have to ask that

reply.missed_thought: check the real page, not only the tests

examples.said: Added the export button and moved the menu.
examples.message: I told you to keep the old menu layout, why did you move it?

reply.missed_thought: the earlier instruction said to keep the layout

examples.message: where is it? send me the link

reply.missed_thought: give the link with the news that it is ready
reply.why: the user could not reach it
reply.concern: being able to open the report

examples.said: Fixed the date on the first page.
examples.message: the other pages show the wrong date too, it goes without saying to fix them all

reply.missed_thought: search for the same fault on the sibling pages
reply.why: only the reported page was fixed

examples.said: Shall I go ahead and merge this?
examples.message: yes, you have full authority, stop asking me

reply.missed_thought: the authority was already given, so act
reply.why: it asked what it was allowed to do

reply.missed_thought: measure the speed before calling it done
reply.why: the slowness was the point of the work

examples.said: Which port should the server listen on?

examples.message: now also add a dark theme
this machine only has 8 GB of memory, so keep the model small

reply.why: a fact only the person had

examples.message: the colours feel too dull, make them bolder

reply.why: a taste reaction to something just shown
